clean10_non_countable_signal_rows.expert_note: Route to future family, not current metal_dependent_hydrolase. Isotuberculosinol synthase is hydrolytic terpene/isoprenoid cyclization chemistry: Tyr-activated water attacks a carbocation intermediate generated by Mg-promoted diphosphate ionization. This follows existing terpene-carbocation out-of-scope precedent rather than metalloprotease/metallophosphatase chemistry.
Route to future family, not current metal_dependent_hydrolase. Tuberculosinol synthase uses the same 3WQL protein/terpene-isoprenoid cyclization logic as m_csa:954; route together with 954.

Needs more evidence / sub-family decision. Arylsulfatase is metal-dependent and hydrolytic, but uses post-translational C-alpha-formylglycine as catalytic nucleophile with Ca-stabilized sulfate/oxyanion. Hold pending decision whether FGly sulfatases are accepted under broad metal-dependent hydrolase or split into a future FGly-sulfatase family.
